children.innerHTML: ACT I · A KEYNOTE, FOR SOFTWARE
Encore is the finance workspace your team already knows how to use, minus the part where it breaks at 40,000 rows. Tonight, we show you everything.
Pause here. Let the circular reference joke land. It always lands.
Hover any cell and Encore narrates the math in plain English. Your auditor may weep.
Fork the model, drag the assumptions, compare side by side. No file named FINAL-v7.
Every chart stays wired to the model. Change a number, the deck follows. Yes, live.
Free for models under 10k rows. $16 per editor for everyone else. No implementation partner, no onboarding call, no kidding.
Import your cursed spreadsheet tonight and Encore untangles it while you sleep: named ranges, broken links, the tab nobody opens. First model migrates free.
